Composition & Indication

Sertraline 50mg — 30 Tablets (Generic for Zoloft®) contains Sertraline Hydrochloride 50 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Tablets at the official 50mg strength. The standard indication is the management of depression and anxiety disorders, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Sertraline 50mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.
